flow_text:
Discovery cohort (Killcoyne et al. 2020)
88 patients, 777 sequenced biopsies
45 progressors, 43 non-progressors

Biopsies with a matched scanned H&E slide
80 patients, 315 endoscopies, 676 biopsies (683 slides)
37 progressors (266 biopsies, 115 endoscopies)
43 non-progressors (410 biopsies, 200 endoscopies)

Primary population: pre-event biopsies
75 patients, 288 endoscopies, 571 biopsies
32 progressors (161 biopsies, 88 endoscopies)
43 non-progressors (410 biopsies, 200 endoscopies)

Secondary population: NDBE pre-event biopsies
71 patients, 240 endoscopies, 438 biopsies
28 progressors (104 biopsies, 68 endoscopies)
43 non-progressors (334 biopsies, 172 endoscopies)
exclusions_text:
No matched slide:
101 biopsies; 8 patients
without any slide
(all progressors)

At or after the first
HGD/IMC endoscopy:
105 biopsies (27 endoscopies);
5 progressors with no
pre-event biopsy

Graded ID or LGD:
133 biopsies; 4 progressors
with no NDBE
pre-event biopsy
